intro: Himalayan Yoga Association in Rishikesh, India — the head branch of Bali Yoga School.

Rishikesh is widely known as the world capital of yoga. The school campus is located in a very peaceful area of Rishikesh away from the daily chaos of the town. Yogi Himanshu, the founder of Bali Yoga School, is from Rishikesh and established Himalayan Yoga Association years before Bali Yoga School. Himalayan Yoga Association has a big premises with a swimming pool and multiple large and bright yoga shalas.
On the weekends, you will be taken to excursions to discover the natural beauty of Rishikesh such as famous temples on top of mountains at the sunrise time, or a waterfall in the forest.

There is Himalayan Yoga Cafe, a vegetarian cafe with an outside seating area with a large fire-pit, as well as Himalayan Organic Store, and Himalayan Yoga Spa in the school terrace where you can receive a variety of Ayurveda massage treatments as well as beauty services.
